object_description: two-level four-branched building with gable roofs
design_condition: Centered within the available plot, the branched volume opens the surrounding landscape and distributes recreation spaces around it, distancing the building from traffic while constraining future territorial management.

positive.statement: The four-branched structure creates beautiful, harmoniously distributed spaces for recreation and outdoor activities.
The gable roofs and non-massive volume dialogue harmoniously with the landscape and existing development.
The architecture is clear, understandable, and fits into the regional environment.
The central location guarantees distance from car traffic.
The three functions are well and clearly distributed within the volume.
The spacious circulation areas allow different uses and educational activities.
The jury salutes the sober and discreet architecture.

negative.statement: The central location conditions the future management of the territory.
The entrances are not clearly identifiable apart from the main entrance.
The main entrance's attached roof seems poorly integrated into the whole.
Natural light may be lacking throughout the building, particularly in the large central square.
